name: Guru Krupa Gems and Jewellery Ltd

facts.business: Guru Krupa Gems and Jewellery Limited is engaged in the trading of gems and jewellery, sourcing finished jewellery from outsourced manufacturers and selling through its operations in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
key_risks: Gold and precious metal price volatility
Concentration of operations in Ahmedabad, Gujarat
Dependence on outsourced manufacturing and limited suppliers
Competitive intensity from large national and regional brands
Absence of trademark and design registration
facts.related_party_note: The Company has, in the ordinary course of business, entered into transactions with related parties, including its Promoters, which may give rise to potential conflicts of interest.
